note: Web copy at 0.6428 x the render; all *_px values and px_per_* are already scaled to this image. Web cutouts (public/art/characters) are 768 x 1152 with feet at 97 % of the height. Cylindrical 180-degree strip. Column: x = width/2 + azimuth * px_per_rad (azimuth in radians from the facing direction, negative = camera's left = image left; heading_deg is the facing direction in the building frame, 0 = +X east, 90 = +Y north). Row: a person at horizontal distance d has feet_y = horizon_y + eye_height/d * px_per_tan and height 1.75/d * px_per_tan px in EVERY column; feet are in frame from min_dist_m outwards. The game shows a 16:9 window (height x 16/9 wide) and pans. Character cutouts (crc-learning-game assets-and-references/characters/*/scenes, 1024 x 1536, feet at ~97 % of the image height, head near the top): scale = person_px / (0.97 * cutout_height_px) where person_px = person_175_px scaled by the character's height / 1.75 m; place the cutout so its bottom edge is at feet_y_px + 0.03 * scaled_height (interpolate person_175_px / feet_y_px between rows). The table is projection only: it says nothing about furniture or walls, so pick a spot with clear floor (or draw foreground objects over the character with a mask).
